Product authority adopts it per project, with adoption and any restricted surface scope recorded in design modules.","exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":571,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/UX.md","quote":"Product authority adopts this profile for a project (§1 Authority), and\nthe adoption is recorded by (P6, P4b):","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/UX.md#UX%2F12.%20Adoption","start_line":570}],"label":"UX profile"}}}

clauses.statement: UX profile: The UX profile governs UX surfaces within its adopted or default scope. Product authority adopts it per project, with adoption and any restricted surface scope recorded in design modules.

Progress categories: Progress is accepted material movement toward the selected outcome. Prerequisite work names the obligation enabled; preservation and repeated proof are evidence without new progress; rejected or superseded construction is churn; discovering hidden distance revises the forecast without being negative progress. These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm.

Implementation must trace to accepted ontology, design and module assets; tests to module ownership. Reconcile implementation-first discoveries into ontology and domain/sequence/state evidence before promotion/closure; hidden controllers or alternative authority cannot compensate for unrealised constructors. Implementation-discovered tests must re-express closure proof against ownership; module boundaries enable common audit without outranking constitutional truth/ratified design. Minimum chain: constitutional WHAT; accepted ontology; target design; target module assets and ontology-derived carriers; accepted domain/sequence/state projections with axiom evaluation; implementation; tests from the same ontology/boundary. With reference realisation: constitutional WHAT; reference design; accepted target ontology plus reference mapping; target design mapping; target module assets/carriers; accepted domain/sequence/state projections with axiom evaluation; implementation/tests from the same ontology. Jumping from design/code to tests without reconstructing module boundaries yields too-weak proof.

clauses.statement: Reporting defects, counterexamples or already-required behaviour alone is not authorship. Adopted wording, design or policy, including particular repair directions, is authorship of that contribution; calling it a finding does not restore independence. Finding a defect grants no review authority. Reading the same governing sources is allowed, but a fresh context grants neither independence nor authority; self-review remains construction output. Received contributions retain their author's identity wherever carried, and that author's reading is not independent acceptance. Independence across actor families must be declared; absent a stated policy, two activations of one model family are not independent for semantic judgment.

clauses.statement: Deferral requires a named proof/cleanup class, debt local to admitted sprint surface, expected correction cost below per-change proof cost, a short enough sprint for reviewability, and close review that classifies and pays down debt. Escrow is explicit and satisfies no method/release/product closure until paid down, accepted or repriced. When governing method permits, eligible classes may include screenshots/walkthrough capture, visual review, accessibility cleanup, UI interaction replay proof, design wording, trace and local realisation cleanup. Escrow must not hide new product truth, changed/new data contracts, runtime/governance/closure/provenance/evidence semantics, missing constructive carriers, changed public published-function/carrier contracts, or law changes requiring goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice or design_reframe. Such findings are recorded and exit through a standalone ticket, repricing action or sprint supersession.

{"family":"constraints","record":{"applies_to":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:record:a8cafeeacc2f8bc2deda01690eaaf31b"],"basis":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:basis","context":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:context:source-first-proposal","id":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:record:a1a34ef803ef75b992fc5a7b64987468","judgment_kind":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:judgment-kind:external-semantic-review","kind":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:constraint-kind:authored-source-statement","latitude_ref":[],"owner":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:actor:f-p-author","predicate":{"conditions":[],"exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":1061,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","quote":"## 5. Traversals and functor kinds

A traversal is a typed contract (P4a, P6):

```text
v = {
  id,
  domain,
  codomain,
  context,
  owner,
  scope,
  basis,
  preconditions,
  postconditions,
  authority,
  evidence,
  provenance,
  stop_states
}
```

The traversal record is this member's own concept. A same-spelled term
owned by a profile, a realisation or a runtime is not imported by nominal
equality and does not specialise this record except through a declared
binding under that owner's authority (§9; P3, P1).

`a_c` defines three fundamental functor-kind identities (P3):

```text
F_D = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-d
F_P = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-p
F_H = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-h
```

Application notation is:

```text
F_K[v](X_v) -> Y_v | Omega_v
```

where `F_K` is one functor kind, `v` is one exact traversal identity,
`X_v` and `Y_v` are its typed input and result domains, and `Omega_v` is
its closed stop algebra. `Omega_v` is a refinement of the core result
algebra of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results): it adds no
core value, and each of its stop values maps to exactly one core value,
never to `satisfied`. A stop this member writes, `hold`, `gap`,
`refusal(constraint)` or `refusal(basis)`, has the meaning and the core
value that AC-007 gives it. The signature's stop contract declares any
further stop value with the one core value it maps to, and may refine a
stop value by cause. A traversal record's `stop_states` binds the stop
mapping of that traversal, exactly one core value for each stop value; it
may refine a value of the signature's stop contract further by cause for
that traversal. Each refined value, whether the stop contract or a
`stop_states` declares it, names its parent value and its cause and maps
to its parent's core value: a value refined from `hold` to indeterminate,
from `gap` or `refusal(basis)` to invalid_basis, and from
`refusal(constraint)` to falsified. No refined value takes `satisfied`. A
different core value needs a different parent value, which only the member
that owns the parent declares; for these four stops that member is this
one. Neither the stop contract nor a traversal's `stop_states` raises a
result's standing (P5, P6). Purpose and material relation: one stop of one
traversal has one core value, so its consumers cannot read it two ways,
and no refinement gives a stop another core value, so a violated
constraint never becomes a case that the evidence merely cannot decide.

- `F_D` classifies total deterministic processing under an exact traversal
  contract. An application declares `f_B:D_B->Outcome_B`, its closed logical
  domain, exact basis, all material computational state and dependencies,
  and its termination argument. For every domain input it terminates with
  exactly one declared outcome. Closed domains may be infinite when
  termination and outcome determination are established. Open-world
  semantic choice and undeclared clock, filesystem or global dependencies
  are outside this contract (P3, P4a, P6).

  Here B is the exact basis of v, D_B is its declared logical input domain
  X_v (including material state and resource inputs), and Outcome_B is the
  declared result-or-stop domain Y_v | Omega_v. The function f_B determines
  one such outcome, including a stop with its closed report where declared;
  that report and its stop are not two outcomes. An enclosing step's output
  availability remains a separate predicate.

  State-dependent processing declares input state and the meaning of its
  returned next state and value. Refusal and exhaustion retain their cause
  and evaluated predicate. The signature and traversal bind each stop to
  exactly one core value, never satisfied; an exhausted tag alone supplies
  no mapping. Construction availability and assessment retain their
  separate predicates and results, and an unperformed assessment has no
  result. A fuel-bounded operation is distinct from the potentially
  divergent operation it bounds. A deterministic decision or effect proposal
  establishes no physical completion, runtime admission, permission or
  quality (P5, P6; [ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition)).
- `F_P` classifies bounded probabilistic interpretation, construction or
  proposal under an exact traversal contract. Its result has no semantic,
  admission, acceptance or closure authority merely because it is useful
  or repeatable (P6, P0; instance premise (iii) of §1 Foundation to law).
- `F_H` classifies explicit human adjudication under an exact identity,
  authority grant, subject, basis and decision contract. Human presence
  grants no ambient authority (P6).

The actor, the executor, the domain operation and the functor kind are
different coordinates. `Encode`, `Interpret`, `Serialize`, `Measure` and
other named domain operations are not aliases for `F_D`, `F_P` or `F_H`.
Different traversals may share one functor kind without sharing identity,
semantics, inputs, outputs, authority or evidence (P3, P6).

Classifying an operation as F_D grants no semantic, evaluation, operation
or decision authority. This is the kind-specific application of
[AC-005](#ac-005-authority-conservation) and
[FOUNDATIONS Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds): the exact
operation contract and admitted grant determine its permissions and
consequences. Consumers apply this boundary to their own operations.

Evaluation-operation profile. An operation declared to evaluate an unchanged
subject identifies that subject, admissible reads, witness or log outputs,
permitted writes, stops and results, authority and invalidation conditions.
It preserves the judged subject and does not perform the domain construction
it judges. Separately authorized persistence of a witness does not perform
the judged domain construction. A construction or mutation needs its own
operation contract and grant; reporting a changed subject's property as the
original subject's property violates this evaluation contract (P6, P3).

Closedness concerns dependencies material to the computation, not complete
world knowledge. This kind's totality is stronger than total handling of
conditions in [ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement).
Unbounded work is not automatically `F_P` when a totality argument is missing.
The calculus does not classify every executable process as one of its kinds.
A new non-total deterministic process is outside qualifying F_D. A route to
an F_D claim is a separately identified bounded successor with its own
domain, outcomes, dependency closure and termination argument; a fuel bound
is one possible construction. This proves nothing about the unbounded
original. Other work remains governed by its selected operation and execution
basis without being asserted to be a qualifying a_c application.
Existing operations enter this edition only through the evidence-sensitive
[migration relation](RELEASE.md#deterministic-kind-migration). The
[finite examples](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md) distinguish construction,
assessment, proposed effects and three predicate-specific exhaustion cases.

"Functor kind" is an `a_c` term for this traversal classification. It does
not by itself assert a category-theoretic functor. A model that claims
categorical functor laws carries the demonstration that
[FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#4-algebra), Formal fragment, requires of
every categorical claim (P6, P1).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F5.%20Traversals%20and%20functor%20kinds","start_line":919}],"statement":"For every admitted input in D_B, f_B must terminate with one declared outcome. Declare every material dependency, including clock, filesystem, globals, external state and effect-relevant inputs. A closed infinite domain is allowed when totality is established. A fuel-bounded wrapper has its own identity and outcome contract; it does not prove the unfuelled operation total.","uncertainty":""},"refusal":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:stop:no-execution-or-acceptance","scope":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:scope:source-corpus"]}}

For each directed relation, the `relation` authority and referenced `contracts`
state, directly or by exact reference:

1. Source and target Product identities and roles; the consumed capability,
   outcome, purpose, selected basis and currentness policy.
2. The existing owners and grants for each material operation: acquisition,
   disclosure, use, execution, mutation, assessment and disposition. A kind or
   role label records no grant by itself.
3. Admissible inputs and exports; material assumptions, effects, failures,
   obligations and evidence; restrictions on implementation material and derived
   information where applicable.
4. The acting principals or binding rule, task/phase scope, permitted delegation,
   return consumer, stop/refusal conditions and revocation/invalidation route.

These coordinates may be supplied by source-linked prose. The relation locates
and constrains lawfully granted authority; it cannot manufacture the target's
permission or the source's admission. Missing material authority or an unresolved
conflict withholds the dependent action. The execution-scoped activation remains
the place where a particular actor, input, effect and return are bound.","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#PRODUCT_DEFINITION%2F9.%20Recursive%20discovery%20and%20explicit%20composition%2FPC-03%20%E2%80%94%20The%20edge%27s%20contract%20and%20authority%20record","start_line":895}],"statement":"Every directed edge binds exact source and target Product identities and roles, capability/interface contract, selected basis and currentness; local/composed outcomes; required inputs, permitted exports, material assumptions, effects, failures, obligations and evidence; and the existing owners/grants for acquisition, disclosure, use, execution, mutation, assessment and disposition. Project the domain into its computational realisation and extend cross-view evaluation to prove they describe one system. Identify fact establishment, consuming operations, applicable basis and invalidators, effect boundaries, retained alternatives and accumulated work using ACTIVATION §§4 and 7; include method and assurance operations where material. Declare supported input dimensions, workload, growth and assumptions needed for the selected outcome; distinguish material startup, framework, external-computation, transport and assurance costs under ACTIVATION §6. Bind any acceptance limits and owner before qualification, challenge assumptions on representative supported paths and material growth, and observe work directly when elapsed time cannot locate it without repeating operations merely to count them. Existing design/proof surfaces suffice; no additional accounting system or fixed complexity is required. Local success and differing names cannot establish whole-path success or different computational responsibilities.

clauses.statement: Derive and validate completeness from authoritative inputs; caller/owner assertions of completeness, validity, prior admission or authority do not establish truth. Bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis through admission. If validity/currentness can advance after preflight, require the declared predecessor/currentness commit condition or effect-free re-entry into derivation and validation. Participating owners bind equal bases or a design-declared coherent composite; independently valid mixed-basis judgments cannot combine. Validate every participant and join before any effect. No subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth; failure/interruption admits the entire transition or none. Direct, supported composite and nested realisations preserve this law; partial results cannot replace an owner's derivation/validation and competing same-scope paths cannot establish transition outside the governing relation. Same-basis reconstruction and replay exactly reproduce enclosing relation, basis identity and complete semantic outcome/refusal. The law is false for asserted-only completeness, omitted relevant participant/join/seam, unidentified/stale/incoherently mixed basis, advancing currentness without condition or effect-free re-entry, premature effect, exposed subset, differing reconstruction or remaining competing authority.

ABG role: ABG is the singular traversal-governance and runtime-truth role. Its owned operations and facts include traversal, dispatch, actor invocation, process supervision, graph-call realisation, runtime facts, event emission/replay, frames, continuations, retry/correction control, closure folds, re-entry after publish boundaries, lineage and provenance. This describes source-defined authority, not an authority granted by this interpretation.

Do this **before the skill's general discovery, classification or subject
reads**, and before effects. The packet permits only its authorized control
reads while activation is being checked; it does not validate itself.

1. Identify the packet's requested frame, consumer and acquisition boundary.
   Read only the named, authorized control inputs needed to verify it: the
   Product Definition, exact installed basis, accepted frame basis, contract/grant,
   applicable admission evidence and required predecessor result. Apply
   [Product Basis Selection](PRODUCT_BASIS.md) inside that search boundary;
   do not broaden discovery to find a more convenient definition. If these
   control reads cannot lawfully resolve the binding, return the mismatch or
   unavailable input without reading the work subject.
2. Compare the actual subject/checkpoint, contract, admission, actor/grants,
   permitted acquisition and required host properties with the packet. Check
   referenced digests/currentness and predecessor validity. Check commands
   and inline material against the same recipient boundary as the issuer.
   A known mismatch returns `activation_refusal` with its cause and the core
   result prescribed by `ACTIVATION` §3; do not manufacture a Worker result
   for an activation that never occurred. Keep an unresolved required binding
   unresolved and return the owning missing-input/capability re-entry.
3. On a valid binding, run this skill's ordinary procedure within the packet's
   frame and grant. Reuse the verified selection and still-valid facts; do not
   ask for admission again merely because a new actor received the work. A
   request to edit, run a command or read another source still needs the
   operation/acquisition authority already bound to it.
4. Record the skill's closed result on the named surface within its write
   grant, then send the permitted return projection to the named consumer.
   A read-only recipient returns through the declared read-only channel; an
   authorized recorder owns any required persistent write. Include exact
   subject/basis, evidence routes, residuals, validity and effect uncertainty.
   If the named result relation cannot be fulfilled, report the obstruction;
   do not redirect the result to an arbitrary file or claim closure. Stop at
   the packet's return boundary.","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#Coordinated%20Skill%20Handoff%2FReceive","start_line":133}],"statement":"Before ordinary skill discovery, verify named authorized controls against packet, actual subject, grant, admission, actor, currentness, predecessor and host requirements. Known mismatch returns activation_refusal with the owning core result, never a Worker result for work that did not activate. Unknown required binding remains unresolved. On valid admission reuse exact still-valid facts without another approval solely for a new actor. Execute only granted operations and reads; record on the named surface only under its write grant, otherwise use the read-only return channel. Return exact subject/basis/evidence/residuals/validity/effect uncertainty and stop at the consumer boundary; no arbitrary output file or invented closure.","uncertainty":""},"refusal":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:stop:no-execution-or-acceptance","scope":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:scope:source-corpus"]}}

On valid admission reuse exact still-valid facts without another approval solely for a new actor. Execute only granted operations and reads; record on the named surface only under its write grant, otherwise use the read-only return channel. Return exact subject/basis/evidence/residuals/validity/effect uncertainty and stop at the consumer boundary; no arbitrary output file or invented closure.

`<project>` is one explicit Project Release Namespace. It matches
`[a-z0-9]+(?:[-_][a-z0-9]+)*`, contains no slash, is unique within the
release source, and remains stable for the continuing release line. It is
assigned by the Product release authority. A directory name, display name,
definition label, package name or matching version cannot infer or
reassign it (P3, P6).

A shared release source uses these exact ref shapes for an RC-profile
publication (P3):

```text
RC branch:              refs/heads/rc/<project>/<version>
immutable RC cut tag:   refs/tags/<project>/v<version>-rc.<n>
version-line selector:  refs/tags/<project>/v<version>
release branch:         refs/heads/release/<project>/<version>
```

The short Git tag names are therefore `<project>/v<version>-rc.<n>` and
`<project>/v<version>`. A shared release source does not publish a future
cut or selector under the unqualified `v<version>-rc.<n>` or `v<version>`
refs (P3).

A single-project release source may retain the unqualified ref profile
only while it has exactly one independently released project and its
release record declares that profile. Adding a second independently
released project requires project-qualified refs before either project
publishes another cut (P3).

For the Specification Stack shared source, the allocated namespaces are
`specification_methodology`, `axiom_indexer` and `stdo_representation`.
These keys distinguish release refs; they do not merge the three Products
or imply a dependency or composition relation (P3, P6).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F2.%20Release%20identities%2FProject-qualified%20Git%20refs","start_line":171},{"end_line":272,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/RELEASE.md","quote":"### Project-subtree release identity

In a shared release source, an immutable cut binds all of (P3):

- the Project Release Namespace and owning Product authority;
- the exact qualified Git ref and annotated tag object;
- the peeled commit and repository-root tree;
- the normalised repository-relative Project Subtree root at that commit;
- the Git tree object at that exact Project Subtree root;
- the declared Product member inventory and release-scoped claim bytes;
  and
- the predecessor and successor dispositions required by §9.

The Project Subtree root is a locator inside the exact peeled commit, not
Product identity. Its canonical spelling is the slash-separated Git path
from the repository root, with no leading or trailing slash and no empty,
`.` or `..` component; `.` alone denotes the repository root. Each
non-root component names the exact tree entry bytes traversed at that
commit. Moving a source project changes this locator and its cut identity
without reassigning the Project Release Namespace. If the source project
occupies the repository root, its project-subtree tree equals the
repository-root tree (P3).

A tag over a monorepo commit does not make sibling subtrees Product
members. Unrelated sibling bytes remain carrier state outside the declared
Product subject. Conversely, a member inventory or payload digest without
the qualified ref, commit, Project Subtree root and Project Subtree tree is
not a complete reacquirable release identity (P3, P6).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F2.%20Release%20identities%2FProject-subtree%20release%20identity","start_line":245},{"end_line":297,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/RELEASE.md","quote":"### Historical ref and public-URI conservation

Project qualification is prospective. Existing unqualified refs retain
their names, objects, peels and public links. A historical tag object may
remain reachable through an additional archival ref, but it is not
recreated, re-annotated, moved or replaced. An immutable historical tag
remains the same object regardless of which preserving ref reaches it
(P3, P4b).

Product-local cut names and public logical release URIs also remain
unchanged. An RC logical STDO release remains
`stdo://releases/v<version>-rc.<n>/`; a stable release uses
`stdo://releases/v<major>.<minor>.<patch>/`. The project-qualified Git ref is
transport identity and is not inserted into that URI. Resolution binds
the public logical cut to its exact historical or project-qualified Git
ref and fails closed if one project-local coordinate names different tag
objects (P3, P5).

When one version line spans the transition, latest means the greatest
positive RC ordinal across that project's preserved historical cuts and
its qualified future cuts. The first qualified publication creates the
qualified selector. The historical unqualified selector is preserved at
its existing object and ceases to be the current selector for the shared
source; it is not force-moved to imitate the qualified namespace (P3).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F2.%20Release%20identities%2FHistorical%20ref%20and%20public-URI%20conservation","start_line":274}],"statement":"Bind project release namespace, repository-relative Product subtree root/tree, exact annotated ref/tag object, peeled commit, repository tree and Product subject inventory. Project refs separate co-resident Products; the shared commit is a carrier, not proof every file belongs to each Product. Preserve historical published refs, identities, URIs and evidence. Qualified spelling clarifies a new cut without moving or retroactively renaming old cuts.","uncertainty":""},"refusal":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:stop:no-execution-or-acceptance","scope":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:scope:source-corpus"]}}

clauses.statement: Bind project release namespace, repository-relative Product subtree root/tree, exact annotated ref/tag object, peeled commit, repository tree and Product subject inventory. Project refs separate co-resident Products; the shared commit is a carrier, not proof every file belongs to each Product. Preserve historical published refs, identities, URIs and evidence. Qualified spelling clarifies a new cut without moving or retroactively renaming old cuts.

The override is published on a lawful domain-authority surface, visible, auditable and recoverable without reverse-engineering implementation regexes. At minimum the domain should publish scoped kinds, their serialisation/readable form, uniqueness scope/hierarchy and grouping versus concrete executable/traceable identity distinctions.

clauses.statement: Every GTL/ABG ODD product must preserve one authoritative traversal-consequence surface: IntentLineage → ProductAssetModel → ObservationSnapshot → GapPressureRow → TargetObligationBinding → PriorityProjection → ConstructionIntent → AdmittedEvidence → EdgeFulfillmentLedger → EdgeClosureDecision → NextActionProjection, with selected outcome/admitted bounded-basis refs also feeding TargetObligationBinding. Method owns process constitution; goals current overriding work concerns; intent domain direction; product-definition current mutable source-project definition; requirements live obligations derived from it; shared/tenant-local design concrete mechanisms. Product definition binds actual authority locations and tenant registry realisations under shared specification. Bound WHAT alone defines WHAT; design/realisation define HOW. Tenants, design, code, definition overlays and derived surfaces never become co-equal with WHAT. Conventional GOALS.md, INTENT.md, PRODUCT.md and specification/requirements/ require no relocation/duplication. Structured requirement families are preferred to an imperative monolithic catch-all; location itself is not constitutional.

clauses.statement: For the predicate that the operation yields its declared result on exact basis: declared result→satisfied, establishing availability of a proposed model/successor only, not acceptance/admission; hold→indeterminate when required evidence/observation/disposition is not yet admitted, naming what decides; gap→invalid_basis when a needed member/reference/resolution/declaration remains unresolved by its declared relation; refusal(constraint)→falsified for a demonstrated law/signature violation by what is judged or any refusal not naming a basis condition; refusal(basis)→invalid_basis for basis conditions without a demonstrated violation by what is judged. A resolved-to-no-target local/external reference is dangling and refuses, distinct from open external resolution. Basis-only causes include inexact seeds/relations/edge semantics/basis/scope, nonfinite/nonunique fixed points, unestablished input identity/basis/admission or mixed bases without composite relation. Refusal names its condition, admits no record/model/carrier and silently drops nothing.

Msg-replay test and proof: Msg-replay test asks whether the view's behavior can be reproduced by replaying its Msg log against empty State. Executable Msg-replay proof is recorded work-state resumption evidence that the view owns no hidden continuation. It includes initial State fixture, ordered Msg log, expected final State, expected ordered Cmds, typed Cmd outcome Msgs including every materially possible unresolved outcome and recovery messages, and injected deterministic time, randomness, generated ids and external payloads.

{"family":"relations","record":{"basis":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:basis","context":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:context:source-first-proposal","id":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:record:a8cd2b58c5ad69bc364adad883cd18ad","kind":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:relation-kind:governing:requires","owner":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:actor:f-p-author","qualifiers":{"conditions":[],"exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":848,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/RELEASE.md","quote":"### Deterministic-kind migration

A successor that adopts the total deterministic kind of
[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds)
preserves each existing evaluation operation's unchanged subject, admissible
reads, witness/log outputs, permitted writes, stops/results, authority and
invalidation conditions. That profile alone does not
establish the new kind's totality, closed dependencies or declared outcomes.
The old deterministic evaluation/proof definition supplies no general
termination argument. Assess each proposed use against this relation (P3, P6):

| Evidence and declared migration status | Successor disposition |
|---|---|
| Establishes the new totality, closed-dependency and outcome contract | Map to common F_D plus the unchanged operation profile and exact traversal binding. Preserve the evidence and grants. |
| New-kind eligibility is unestablished, and the owner has identified the missing evidence or a separately declared bounded successor and its remediation obligation | Keep that identified migration pending. The legacy operation retains only its lawful standing on its exact old basis while it remains applicable; it gains no successor F_D standing. A narrower domain or fuel-bounded implementation has its own contract, identity, exhaustion outcomes and affected preservation evidence; it does not retrospectively prove the old operation total or preserve every old continuation. |
| New-kind eligibility is unestablished and no supported remediation or successor classification has been selected | Retain the exact legacy meaning and evidence with an explicit unresolved successor-classification obligation until its owner disposes it. The legacy operation retains only its lawful standing on its exact old basis while applicable. Grant neither new F_D standing nor an automatic F_P label; the affected successor claim stays open. |

An old deterministic evaluator with unestablished termination or an
undeclared material dependency takes the second or third row, even if it
preserves the judged subject: the second row requires an identified evidence
gap/remediation or selected bounded successor; absent that, the third records
the unresolved classification. Evidence alone need not choose the owner's
remediation. This relation imposes no general decision procedure for totality.
These eligibility/remediation cases are not additional semantic dispositions
under this section. Generic role descriptions and schematic traversal contracts are not concrete
operations with an implementation to qualify; their use still binds the
kind and operation contracts when instantiated.

ODD admission and closure retain their named operation owners under
[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5's authority boundary](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds).
Exhaustion
retains the evaluated predicate and its signature/traversal stop mapping,
as [the conformance examples](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md) distinguish.

Immutable consumers keep their selected edition's meaning. New consumers
explicitly select the complete successor and operation profiles. A stable
concept URN is not its immutable calculus edition
([AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §8](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#8-calculus-identity)). Migration
records the old release, manifest, member and clauses and the applicable row
above. Current URN lookup never reinterprets history. A versioned import or
alias records its justified supersession and grants no broader permission.
Disposition and qualification retain the separate obligations of this
section; unresolved mappings block the affected successor claim.

Broadening operation purpose while strengthening totality, dependency and
evidence requirements is a substantive semantic change. A patch-shaped
version label by itself promises no compatibility. The release's version
assessment identifies the selected predecessor, affected consumer mappings
and remaining obligations. This relation settles no general version-line
policy and waives no acceptance gate.","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/RELEASE.md#RELEASE%2F9.%20Successor%20baseline%20conservation%20%28STDO-UP-015%29%2FDeterministic-kind%20migration","start_line":799},{"end_line":1061,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","quote":"## 5. Traversals and functor kinds

A traversal is a typed contract (P4a, P6):

```text
v = {
  id,
  domain,
  codomain,
  context,
  owner,
  scope,
  basis,
  preconditions,
  postconditions,
  authority,
  evidence,
  provenance,
  stop_states
}
```

The traversal record is this member's own concept. A same-spelled term
owned by a profile, a realisation or a runtime is not imported by nominal
equality and does not specialise this record except through a declared
binding under that owner's authority (§9; P3, P1).

`a_c` defines three fundamental functor-kind identities (P3):

```text
F_D = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-d
F_P = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-p
F_H = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-h
```

Application notation is:

```text
F_K[v](X_v) -> Y_v | Omega_v
```

where `F_K` is one functor kind, `v` is one exact traversal identity,
`X_v` and `Y_v` are its typed input and result domains, and `Omega_v` is
its closed stop algebra. `Omega_v` is a refinement of the core result
algebra of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results): it adds no
core value, and each of its stop values maps to exactly one core value,
never to `satisfied`. A stop this member writes, `hold`, `gap`,
`refusal(constraint)` or `refusal(basis)`, has the meaning and the core
value that AC-007 gives it. The signature's stop contract declares any
further stop value with the one core value it maps to, and may refine a
stop value by cause. A traversal record's `stop_states` binds the stop
mapping of that traversal, exactly one core value for each stop value; it
may refine a value of the signature's stop contract further by cause for
that traversal. Each refined value, whether the stop contract or a
`stop_states` declares it, names its parent value and its cause and maps
to its parent's core value: a value refined from `hold` to indeterminate,
from `gap` or `refusal(basis)` to invalid_basis, and from
`refusal(constraint)` to falsified. No refined value takes `satisfied`. A
different core value needs a different parent value, which only the member
that owns the parent declares; for these four stops that member is this
one. Neither the stop contract nor a traversal's `stop_states` raises a
result's standing (P5, P6). Purpose and material relation: one stop of one
traversal has one core value, so its consumers cannot read it two ways,
and no refinement gives a stop another core value, so a violated
constraint never becomes a case that the evidence merely cannot decide.

- `F_D` classifies total deterministic processing under an exact traversal
  contract. An application declares `f_B:D_B->Outcome_B`, its closed logical
  domain, exact basis, all material computational state and dependencies,
  and its termination argument. For every domain input it terminates with
  exactly one declared outcome. Closed domains may be infinite when
  termination and outcome determination are established. Open-world
  semantic choice and undeclared clock, filesystem or global dependencies
  are outside this contract (P3, P4a, P6).

  Here B is the exact basis of v, D_B is its declared logical input domain
  X_v (including material state and resource inputs), and Outcome_B is the
  declared result-or-stop domain Y_v | Omega_v. The function f_B determines
  one such outcome, including a stop with its closed report where declared;
  that report and its stop are not two outcomes. An enclosing step's output
  availability remains a separate predicate.

  State-dependent processing declares input state and the meaning of its
  returned next state and value. Refusal and exhaustion retain their cause
  and evaluated predicate. The signature and traversal bind each stop to
  exactly one core value, never satisfied; an exhausted tag alone supplies
  no mapping. Construction availability and assessment retain their
  separate predicates and results, and an unperformed assessment has no
  result. A fuel-bounded operation is distinct from the potentially
  divergent operation it bounds. A deterministic decision or effect proposal
  establishes no physical completion, runtime admission, permission or
  quality (P5, P6; [ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition)).
- `F_P` classifies bounded probabilistic interpretation, construction or
  proposal under an exact traversal contract. Its result has no semantic,
  admission, acceptance or closure authority merely because it is useful
  or repeatable (P6, P0; instance premise (iii) of §1 Foundation to law).
- `F_H` classifies explicit human adjudication under an exact identity,
  authority grant, subject, basis and decision contract. Human presence
  grants no ambient authority (P6).

The actor, the executor, the domain operation and the functor kind are
different coordinates. `Encode`, `Interpret`, `Serialize`, `Measure` and
other named domain operations are not aliases for `F_D`, `F_P` or `F_H`.
Different traversals may share one functor kind without sharing identity,
semantics, inputs, outputs, authority or evidence (P3, P6).

Classifying an operation as F_D grants no semantic, evaluation, operation
or decision authority. This is the kind-specific application of
[AC-005](#ac-005-authority-conservation) and
[FOUNDATIONS Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds): the exact
operation contract and admitted grant determine its permissions and
consequences. Consumers apply this boundary to their own operations.

Evaluation-operation profile. An operation declared to evaluate an unchanged
subject identifies that subject, admissible reads, witness or log outputs,
permitted writes, stops and results, authority and invalidation conditions.
It preserves the judged subject and does not perform the domain construction
it judges. Separately authorized persistence of a witness does not perform
the judged domain construction. A construction or mutation needs its own
operation contract and grant; reporting a changed subject's property as the
original subject's property violates this evaluation contract (P6, P3).

Closedness concerns dependencies material to the computation, not complete
world knowledge. This kind's totality is stronger than total handling of
conditions in [ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement).
Unbounded work is not automatically `F_P` when a totality argument is missing.
The calculus does not classify every executable process as one of its kinds.
A new non-total deterministic process is outside qualifying F_D. A route to
an F_D claim is a separately identified bounded successor with its own
domain, outcomes, dependency closure and termination argument; a fuel bound
is one possible construction. This proves nothing about the unbounded
original. Other work remains governed by its selected operation and execution
basis without being asserted to be a qualifying a_c application.
Existing operations enter this edition only through the evidence-sensitive
[migration relation](RELEASE.md#deterministic-kind-migration). The
[finite examples](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md) distinguish construction,
assessment, proposed effects and three predicate-specific exhaustion cases.

"Functor kind" is an `a_c` term for this traversal classification. It does
not by itself assert a category-theoretic functor. A model that claims
categorical functor laws carries the demonstration that
[FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#4-algebra), Formal fragment, requires of
every categorical claim (P6, P1).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F5.%20Traversals%20and%20functor%20kinds","start_line":919}],"kind":"requires","meaning":"Migration to common F_D depends on the exact current eligibility contract rather than legacy naming."},"scope":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:scope:source-corpus"],"source":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:record:0c69238f81d7d074e17f3a50187701d5","target":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:record:ca68660343c8147e751d945925622782"}}

A permitted context can be inadequate; an informative context can be forbidden. Derivation, prior exposure and onward disclosure remain material beyond filesystem paths.","exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":962,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md","quote":"### PC-05 — Context construction and clean-room conditions

An actor's selected context must satisfy both permission and adequacy for its
engagement. Permission covers the source information and permitted derivations,
not only paths or filenames. The boundary identifies eligible source classes,
exports and tool outputs, material provenance, intended use, later acquisitions
and the effect of prior exposure. An allowed file location or a fresh summary
does not sanitize prohibited information.

A target owner may authorize an export, but clean-room eligibility additionally
requires that the engagement's information policy admits that export and its
provenance. The actual delivered/acquired material must be recorded to the extent
required by the claim. An uncertain or prohibited exposure follows the declared
hold/re-entry rule; it cannot be repaired by deleting its receipt or relabeling
the same actor fresh. Prior actor knowledge and external acquisition channels are
part of the declared limits.

Adequacy retains the distinctions required for the task's decisions and
continuations, including unresolved obligations, result standing, currentness and
authority. If the permitted material is insufficient, acquire an authorized
extension, narrow the task with the owner, use a suitable actor or return the
unresolved outcome. Permission is not evidence of sufficiency, and a budget is
not permission to omit a deciding condition. This applies [FOUNDATIONS Observation sufficiency](FOUNDATIONS.md#assurance-relations)
and its scoped preservation law; it supplies no general optimal context selector (P1, P2, P6).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#PRODUCT_DEFINITION%2F9.%20Recursive%20discovery%20and%20explicit%20composition%2FPC-05%20%E2%80%94%20Context%20construction%20and%20clean-room%20conditions","start_line":939}],"label":"Context permission and adequacy"}}}

clauses.statement: Context permission and adequacy: Permission to acquire and use information and sufficiency of that information for the selected claim are separate predicates. A permitted context can be inadequate; an informative context can be forbidden. Derivation, prior exposure and onward disclosure remain material beyond filesystem paths.

For a strict selected tool-acquisition boundary, use the concrete
[host adapter and its limits](HOST_BINDING.md). Do not assume the ordinary
host permission prompt or a fresh actor supplies that boundary.

Use the host's actually available delegation or separate-session mechanism.
Record the selected actor/model where exposed, worksite, supplied packet,
inherited history/instructions, available tool/permission settings and return
channel. Respect the admitted context/resource envelope. Unknown required
properties withhold dispatch; optional unobserved properties are explicit
limits. Tool availability alone grants no operation.

- **Codex:** inspect the exposed delegation/session controls. Where the host
  offers conversation inheritance or forking, choose a packet-only context
  when the frame requires it and bind any other automatically supplied
  instructions. A resumed actor retains its earlier context; use it only
  when that context is permitted. Return and wait through the actual actor
  identity, not an invented worker name. If this host has no suitable
  delegation mechanism, return the prepared packet without claiming dispatch.
- **Claude:** select the available subagent/session mechanism and inspect the
  selected agent definition, inherited instructions, tool permissions and
  worksite. Supply the packet and target skill explicitly. A subagent label
  or a resumed session does not establish a clean context. Return through
  the actual task/result mechanism; if its properties cannot meet a required
  boundary, return the unsupported activation rather than silently executing
  in the issuer's context.

Neither host's fresh context alone proves information-flow enforcement or
independent assessment. Independence additionally uses `EVALUATION` §3's
authorship and evidence conditions and the Product's actor-family policy.
Do not broaden permissions, change host configuration or install a runtime
to make a dispatch work without the existing authority for those effects.","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#Coordinated%20Skill%20Handoff%2FHost%20Binding","start_line":247},{"end_line":7,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/references/HOST_BINDING.md","quote":"# Bind The Actual Host

The Product supplies the actor's required context/acquisition boundary and
operation grant. Bind the actual session to it before dependent work. These
adapters project an already-authorized policy; they create no admission and
are optional when a Product already selects sufficient tools. Use those
declared tools rather than installing a competing mechanism.","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/references/HOST_BINDING.md#Bind%20The%20Actual%20Host","start_line":1}],"label":"Actual host acquisition boundary"}}}

When findings from a review need a durable work carrier, record one linked bug
report for that review, with one entry per finding: stable identity, original
Reviewer severity and triage, exact subject/basis, violated claim, location and
chaseable evidence. Link it to the work item that issued the review. With no
findings, create no bug report. A sufficient existing direct-work carrier may
carry the same relations without a redundant ticket (P3, P2).

The Reviewer may record this report only when its activation grants the exact
artifact identity/path and effects. Otherwise it returns the findings and a
lawful Writer records them. Recording creates no repair, priority, admission or
closure authority. Keep the report within its evidence/read and visibility
restrictions: findings derived from a withheld capture are withheld from the
same recipients, including any report projection that reveals them. The
Product may bind a recognizable report naming pattern and exclusion route to
its actual access mechanism; a filename or separate lane alone enforces
nothing and grants no additional read (P6).

After Executive or other authorized decision-owner triage, the reviewed work
item carries a linked Bug items section. Each item records its identity,
original severity, assigned priority and reason, cause group, responsible owner,
source report/finding, disposition and state. The report remains the technical
finding source; the item is the decision and repair ledger. An actor/session
index, where used, points the Reviewer to its report and the triage/repair work
to the reviewed work item's ledger, rather than duplicating that truth (P3).

| Item state | Required trace |
|---|---|
| open | Finding and triage/disposition, with unresolved work named. |
| fixed | Exact repaired subject (commit or equivalent immutable identity) and repair evidence; not yet a claim of verification. |
| verified | The satisfied repair predicate and exact evidence; identify tests and, when required, the independent recheck/report. Tests alone are not labelled independent review. |

These are carrier states, not core evaluation results or acceptance. A required
recheck keeps its affected items unverified until the required result is
available and applicable. A test-verified fix needs no invented Reviewer when
the governing basis requires none; the optional Executive cadence is
[EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §12](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#qa-cadence-and-repair-rechecks).
Retained or deferred findings stay linked until their selected boundary, or
transfer with owner, disposition and destination when the work item closes.
Changing priority does not erase the original severity or the obligation (P6,
P4b).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FReview%20findings%20and%20bug%20items","start_line":536}],"statement":"Every configuration keeps severity, priority, boundary effect and disposition distinct even when Product policy maps values. The rule applies to any assessor/owner; EXECUTIVE_BASELINE is an instance binding. clauses.statement: Every configuration keeps severity, priority, boundary effect and disposition distinct even when Product policy maps values. A recommended disposition is evidence, not priority/boundary effect/disposition, and is never adopted mechanically. Profiles declare fields; Products bind scales. An adjacent out-of-claim observation returns separately with claim-relative triage not_applicable and exact repricing/re-entry pressure; the decision owner routes it to its declared owner without a claim-relative block or new review round from severity alone. The assessor returns to the decision owner, not constructor, and neither edits the candidate, directs repair nor authorises continuation. The rule applies to any assessor/owner; EXECUTIVE_BASELINE is an instance binding. This excludes candidate mutation and repair; an independently bound grant may authorize only the exact finding-report write under TICKETS §4, retaining its visibility and source linkage.

{"family":"constraints","record":{"applies_to":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:record:62c03e6b02ba6e5c63e0e2e4c0dad571"],"basis":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:basis","context":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:context:source-first-proposal","id":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:record:acdc2e3b6ee8e38dfa985bc3a4db288d","judgment_kind":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:judgment-kind:external-semantic-review","kind":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:constraint-kind:authored-source-statement","latitude_ref":[],"owner":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:actor:f-p-author","predicate":{"conditions":[],"exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":350,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md","quote":"## 4. Shared installed release basis and toolchain manager

Within the product-definition-routing context an Installed Release Basis
is the pair (P3):

```text
(immutable stdo://releases/<cut>/ URI, installed-manifest SHA-256)
```

The URI identifies one immutable annotated release cut. The digest identifies
the deterministic installed-release manifest, which binds the cut's tag
object, commit, repository tree, standards subtree, exact standards
inventory, member bytes and admitted auxiliary payloads. The manifest shape
is owned by `schemas/installed-release-manifest.schema.json`. The manifest
is transport and integrity evidence, not a replacement constitution (P6).

An Adoption Plan is the read-only, deterministic acceptance object that
binds one current Product Definition's identity and bytes to its current
basis and to one resolved immutable target's cut, annotated tag object,
commit, tree and installed-manifest digest. Its SHA-256 is the
operator-presentable acceptance token. Possession of the token alone grants
no authority; a mismatch proves that the presented subject is no longer the
subject being mutated (P6, P3). A Fleet Adoption Plan binds an authorised
fleet root and the complete ordered set of per-definition plan digests
under the same law.

Plan hashing covers the acceptance object only: local installation status
and machine-local install paths are excluded. The canonical bytes are UTF-8
JSON with recursively sorted object keys, two-space indentation, LF line
endings and one final LF. Fleet order is deterministic discovery-path
order. These rules make a presented digest independently reproducible
rather than an opaque session token (P3, P6).

The STDO Toolchain Manager is the bounded executable realisation that (P2,
P3):

- installs each immutable cut once in a shared, versioned release store;
- resolves logical `stdo://releases/...` URIs to verified installed bytes;
- inventories and verifies complete installed distributions;
- synchronises the exact basis already selected by a Product Definition;
- emits an exact digest-bound adoption plan from a release-profile discovery
  route and performs adoption only when that plan is explicitly
  accepted;
- manages the stable marker-bounded bootstrap in declared agent files; and
- applies those operations to an explicitly discovered fleet of Product
  Definitions.

The store may live at any machine-local path. Its registry maps logical
release URIs to installed paths and manifest digests and owns neither
Product selection nor method meaning. A consumer repository therefore needs
no project-local standards copy and no prescribed folder structure, and
several Product Definitions on one machine may select different installed
cuts concurrently (P3, P6). Every manager-owned component from the
configured store root downward is a physical directory or regular file of
its declared type; a symlink, junction, reparse point, device, socket or
other redirection or special entry fails closed. Verification inventories
every filesystem entry type, directories included, rejects any entry not
derived from the manifest's exact file paths, and never follows an
unmanifested alias (P5, P3).

`constitution.stdo.source.repository` identifies the transport source.
`constitution.stdo.selector` is a `stdo://channels/<version>` discovery
route whose profile semantics are owned by [RELEASE §4](RELEASE.md#4-selector-and-consumer-adoption).
An RC line resolves its mutable selector; a stable line resolves its exact
immutable cut without a second selector. Neither discovery nor the transport
source is operative authority.
`constitution.stdo.basis.uri` and `constitution.stdo.basis.manifest_sha256`
are the sole authored STDO selection for that Product Definition (P6, P3).

The manager observes these command boundaries (P6, P5):

- `install` admits one explicitly named immutable release cut without changing
  any Product Definition;
- `sync` installs and verifies only the exact basis already selected by
  the Product Definition and never consults its mutable selector;
- `adopt --dry-run` resolves the selected release profile and immutable cut, and
  presents the target cut, tag object, commit, tree, manifest digest,
  current Product-Definition byte digest and a deterministic
  adoption-plan digest, without mutation;
- mutating `adopt` requires that exact prior plan digest as explicit
  acceptance, re-derives it before installation, installs only the bound
  target, rechecks the Product Definition bytes, and atomically changes
  only its basis and its basis-relative schema locator; any drift refuses
  mutation;
- `status`, `verify`, `list`, `manifest` and `resolve` are read-only with
  respect to Product Definitions; and
- fleet adoption emits, and requires explicit acceptance of, one aggregate
  plan digest over every per-definition plan; all fleet writes require
  explicit whole-selection authorisation and infer no composition or
  inheritance from directory nesting.

Missing cuts, moved immutable tags, tag-to-commit mismatch, manifest-digest
mismatch, missing, extra or changed installed members, ambiguous Product
Definition discovery, unaccepted or stale adoption plans, URI escape,
physical store redirection, undeclared filesystem entry types and malformed
bootstrap markers fail closed (P5). Every `stdo:` schema locator is parsed
before schema loading under URI scheme case-insensitivity and names the
same immutable cut as `constitution.stdo.basis`; spelling variation cannot
cross that basis. No cache, registry entry, source checkout, version alias,
schema or agent file may silently replace the basis selected in the
Product Definition (P6, P3).

`constitution.agent_bootstrap` embeds no other constitution. It names one
basis-qualified bootstrap entrypoint and the local instruction files (such
as `AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md` targets) whose small discovery block the
manager owns between explicit markers. Each target is a portable relative
path resolved against `product.source_project`; absolute paths, parent
traversal, redirected path components and escape from that boundary fail
closed. A fleet additionally confines every resolved source project to its
explicitly authorised fleet root and preflights every target before the
first write. Exactly one correctly ordered marker span may be replaced;
the bytes before and after it, trailing whitespace included, stay
project-owned and byte-identical, and appending a new span preserves all
existing bytes as an exact prefix. The bootstrap routes agents to the
applicable Product Definition, the exact installed basis and the owning
sources; it can neither restate nor override them (P6, P3, P5).

Recursive fleet discovery prunes these exact directory names as
version-control, dependency, generated, cache or managed-store internals:
`.git`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `.bzr`, `.venv`, `venv`, `node_modules`, `vendor`,
`site-packages`, `build`, `dist`, `out`, `target`, `.gradle`, `.tox`,
`.nox`, `.cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `.mypy_cache`, `.pytest_cache`,
`__pycache__`, `.genesis` and `.stdo`. A discovered Product Definition may
not itself be a symlink. These exclusions are discovery law, not evidence
that an excluded tree lacks another independently governed Product (P5,
P6).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#PRODUCT_DEFINITION%2F4.%20Shared%20installed%20release%20basis%20and%20toolchain%20manager","start_line":225}],"statement":"install takes an explicitly named exact immutable cut without changing Definitions; sync installs/verifies only the selected exact basis without following discovery. adopt dry-run presents exact target/tag/commit/tree/manifest/current-Definition-byte/plan digests without mutation; mutating adoption requires acceptance of that exact plan, rederives it, installs only the bound target, rechecks Definition bytes and atomically changes only basis and basis-relative schema. Drift refuses. status, verify, list, manifest and resolve are Definition-read-only. Fleet writes require accepted aggregate plan and whole-selection authority; nesting supplies neither composition nor inheritance. Missing cuts, moved tags, identity/inventory drift, ambiguous discovery, unaccepted/stale plans, URI/path escape, redirected store or malformed markers fail closed.","uncertainty":""},"refusal":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:stop:no-execution-or-acceptance","scope":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:scope:source-corpus"]}}

A Product offered as a standalone constituent must be enterable through its own
Product Definition and a Product-authorized applicable frame basis, with the
dependency closure and capabilities its contract declares. Entry must not require

Evaluation and construction remain separate operation purposes even when both use deterministic processing.","exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":1061,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md","quote":"## 5. Traversals and functor kinds

A traversal is a typed contract (P4a, P6):

```text
v = {
  id,
  domain,
  codomain,
  context,
  owner,
  scope,
  basis,
  preconditions,
  postconditions,
  authority,
  evidence,
  provenance,
  stop_states
}
```

The traversal record is this member's own concept. A same-spelled term
owned by a profile, a realisation or a runtime is not imported by nominal
equality and does not specialise this record except through a declared
binding under that owner's authority (§9; P3, P1).

`a_c` defines three fundamental functor-kind identities (P3):

```text
F_D = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-d
F_P = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-p
F_H = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-h
```

Application notation is:

```text
F_K[v](X_v) -> Y_v | Omega_v
```

where `F_K` is one functor kind, `v` is one exact traversal identity,
`X_v` and `Y_v` are its typed input and result domains, and `Omega_v` is
its closed stop algebra. `Omega_v` is a refinement of the core result
algebra of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results): it adds no
core value, and each of its stop values maps to exactly one core value,
never to `satisfied`. A stop this member writes, `hold`, `gap`,
`refusal(constraint)` or `refusal(basis)`, has the meaning and the core
value that AC-007 gives it. The signature's stop contract declares any
further stop value with the one core value it maps to, and may refine a
stop value by cause. A traversal record's `stop_states` binds the stop
mapping of that traversal, exactly one core value for each stop value; it
may refine a value of the signature's stop contract further by cause for
that traversal. Each refined value, whether the stop contract or a
`stop_states` declares it, names its parent value and its cause and maps
to its parent's core value: a value refined from `hold` to indeterminate,
from `gap` or `refusal(basis)` to invalid_basis, and from
`refusal(constraint)` to falsified. No refined value takes `satisfied`. A
different core value needs a different parent value, which only the member
that owns the parent declares; for these four stops that member is this
one. Neither the stop contract nor a traversal's `stop_states` raises a
result's standing (P5, P6). Purpose and material relation: one stop of one
traversal has one core value, so its consumers cannot read it two ways,
and no refinement gives a stop another core value, so a violated
constraint never becomes a case that the evidence merely cannot decide.

- `F_D` classifies total deterministic processing under an exact traversal
  contract. An application declares `f_B:D_B->Outcome_B`, its closed logical
  domain, exact basis, all material computational state and dependencies,
  and its termination argument. For every domain input it terminates with
  exactly one declared outcome. Closed domains may be infinite when
  termination and outcome determination are established. Open-world
  semantic choice and undeclared clock, filesystem or global dependencies
  are outside this contract (P3, P4a, P6).

  Here B is the exact basis of v, D_B is its declared logical input domain
  X_v (including material state and resource inputs), and Outcome_B is the
  declared result-or-stop domain Y_v | Omega_v. The function f_B determines
  one such outcome, including a stop with its closed report where declared;
  that report and its stop are not two outcomes. An enclosing step's output
  availability remains a separate predicate.

  State-dependent processing declares input state and the meaning of its
  returned next state and value. Refusal and exhaustion retain their cause
  and evaluated predicate. The signature and traversal bind each stop to
  exactly one core value, never satisfied; an exhausted tag alone supplies
  no mapping. Construction availability and assessment retain their
  separate predicates and results, and an unperformed assessment has no
  result. A fuel-bounded operation is distinct from the potentially
  divergent operation it bounds. A deterministic decision or effect proposal
  establishes no physical completion, runtime admission, permission or
  quality (P5, P6; [ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#3-step-results-and-disposition)).
- `F_P` classifies bounded probabilistic interpretation, construction or
  proposal under an exact traversal contract. Its result has no semantic,
  admission, acceptance or closure authority merely because it is useful
  or repeatable (P6, P0; instance premise (iii) of §1 Foundation to law).
- `F_H` classifies explicit human adjudication under an exact identity,
  authority grant, subject, basis and decision contract. Human presence
  grants no ambient authority (P6).

The actor, the executor, the domain operation and the functor kind are
different coordinates. `Encode`, `Interpret`, `Serialize`, `Measure` and
other named domain operations are not aliases for `F_D`, `F_P` or `F_H`.
Different traversals may share one functor kind without sharing identity,
semantics, inputs, outputs, authority or evidence (P3, P6).

Classifying an operation as F_D grants no semantic, evaluation, operation
or decision authority. This is the kind-specific application of
[AC-005](#ac-005-authority-conservation) and
[FOUNDATIONS Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds): the exact
operation contract and admitted grant determine its permissions and
consequences. Consumers apply this boundary to their own operations.

Evaluation-operation profile. An operation declared to evaluate an unchanged
subject identifies that subject, admissible reads, witness or log outputs,
permitted writes, stops and results, authority and invalidation conditions.
It preserves the judged subject and does not perform the domain construction
it judges. Separately authorized persistence of a witness does not perform
the judged domain construction. A construction or mutation needs its own
operation contract and grant; reporting a changed subject's property as the
original subject's property violates this evaluation contract (P6, P3).

Closedness concerns dependencies material to the computation, not complete
world knowledge. This kind's totality is stronger than total handling of
conditions in [ACTIVATION §4](ACTIVATION.md#4-totality-and-refinement).
Unbounded work is not automatically `F_P` when a totality argument is missing.
The calculus does not classify every executable process as one of its kinds.
A new non-total deterministic process is outside qualifying F_D. A route to
an F_D claim is a separately identified bounded successor with its own
domain, outcomes, dependency closure and termination argument; a fuel bound
is one possible construction. This proves nothing about the unbounded
original. Other work remains governed by its selected operation and execution
basis without being asserted to be a qualifying a_c application.
Existing operations enter this edition only through the evidence-sensitive
[migration relation](RELEASE.md#deterministic-kind-migration). The
[finite examples](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md) distinguish construction,
assessment, proposed effects and three predicate-specific exhaustion cases.

"Functor kind" is an `a_c` term for this traversal classification. It does
not by itself assert a category-theoretic functor. A model that claims
categorical functor laws carries the demonstration that
[FOUNDATIONS §4](FOUNDATIONS.md#4-algebra), Formal fragment, requires of
every categorical claim (P6, P1).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/standards/AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS%2F5.%20Traversals%20and%20functor%20kinds","start_line":919}],"label":"F_D evaluation profile"}}}

clauses.statement: F_D evaluation profile: A declared evaluation operation using common F_D judges the unchanged subject under its exact predicate and basis. Evaluation and construction remain separate operation purposes even when both use deterministic processing.

Independence is claim-relative and imposes no actor count. Read the exact own contract or intake named in the request before any general
search or project read. Bind your own permitted inputs, exclusions and return
route, then apply [Control Intake](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#control-intake).
This applies to issuer, recipient and direct work. Use named control routes;
do not start with directory inventories, memory searches or neighbouring
prompts. A Worker’s access never becomes its issuer’s access. Check the actual
host boundary before relying on excluded information staying unavailable.","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/skills/stdo-ticket/SKILL.md#STDO%20Ticket%2FStart%20With%20Your%20Own%20Control%20Intake","start_line":10},{"end_line":45,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/skills/stdo-ticket/SKILL.md","quote":"## Choose The Entry

If receiving a coordinated packet, apply
[Receive](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#receive) before general
discovery or ticket reads, then perform only its authorized carrier operation
using the procedure below. Ticket-state authority is distinct from admission
of the implementation the ticket describes.

A coordinating issuer uses [Issue](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#issue)
with the exact ticket-state operation, subject, territory and result surface.
An Executive delegates all ticket edits, including frontmatter-only
supersession, to the separately bound Writer. If its own frame cannot read the
ticket, use permitted identity/metadata and an authorized reader's closed
result; do not infer semantic closure from metadata. Unavailable sufficient
evidence withholds the dependent operation. Evaluate
[the return](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#evaluate-the-return)
and stop at the declared boundary. A sufficient permitted direct Writer uses
the ordinary procedure below.

Before requesting admission or an owner choice, check the exact existing
instruction, standing ruling or admitted grant and its applicability. If it
already covers the operation, record that binding instead of asking again.
For a missing material choice, lead with the concrete decision needed: the
carrier/contract identity and digest where applicable, bounded effect and
unresolved choice. Ask through the owning admission mechanism; no universal
human phrase or additional approval round is required (`ACTIVATION` §1 and §7).","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/skills/stdo-ticket/SKILL.md#STDO%20Ticket%2FChoose%20The%20Entry","start_line":20}],"statement":"Apply own control intake before ordinary discovery or procedure. Issuer remains coordinator; recipient verifies controls before subject reads; a sufficient direct invocation proceeds within its existing authority.","uncertainty":""},"refusal":"urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:stop:no-execution-or-acceptance","scope":["urn:a-c:generation:ba37e2825e4e3c758a5cfaec:scope:source-corpus"]}}

Only a valid binding enters ordinary skill execution.","exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":167,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md","quote":"## Receive

Do this **before the skill's general discovery, classification or subject
reads**, and before effects. The packet permits only its authorized control
reads while activation is being checked; it does not validate itself.

1. Identify the packet's requested frame, consumer and acquisition boundary.
   Read only the named, authorized control inputs needed to verify it: the
   Product Definition, exact installed basis, accepted frame basis, contract/grant,
   applicable admission evidence and required predecessor result. Apply
   [Product Basis Selection](PRODUCT_BASIS.md) inside that search boundary;
   do not broaden discovery to find a more convenient definition. If these
   control reads cannot lawfully resolve the binding, return the mismatch or
   unavailable input without reading the work subject.
2. Compare the actual subject/checkpoint, contract, admission, actor/grants,
   permitted acquisition and required host properties with the packet. Check
   referenced digests/currentness and predecessor validity. Check commands
   and inline material against the same recipient boundary as the issuer.
   A known mismatch returns `activation_refusal` with its cause and the core
   result prescribed by `ACTIVATION` §3; do not manufacture a Worker result
   for an activation that never occurred. Keep an unresolved required binding
   unresolved and return the owning missing-input/capability re-entry.
3. On a valid binding, run this skill's ordinary procedure within the packet's
   frame and grant. Reuse the verified selection and still-valid facts; do not
   ask for admission again merely because a new actor received the work. A
   request to edit, run a command or read another source still needs the
   operation/acquisition authority already bound to it.
4. Record the skill's closed result on the named surface within its write
   grant, then send the permitted return projection to the named consumer.
   A read-only recipient returns through the declared read-only channel; an
   authorized recorder owns any required persistent write. Include exact
   subject/basis, evidence routes, residuals, validity and effect uncertainty.
   If the named result relation cannot be fulfilled, report the obstruction;
   do not redirect the result to an arbitrary file or claim closure. Stop at
   the packet's return boundary.","section":"urn:a-c:project:8ae07eeca101a93be143e873f9d12ab43e316ef0359058c0c9fa71380880d2d5/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.0.5-rc.1/source/plugins/spec/references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#Coordinated%20Skill%20Handoff%2FReceive","start_line":133}],"label":"Verified recipient activation"}}}
